big_pour.headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 per share
big_pour.summary: Anthropic has reportedly priced its IPO at $83 a share, exceeding its projected range. This valuation places the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.
big_pour.why: This massive valuation signals how much investors believe in the future of AI companies.
